title: SunCulture's Move From a $4,500 Kit to a $100 Deposit
conflicts: First kit price: KSh 380,000/US$4,500 (How we made it in Africa, 2013) vs about $5,000 (founders, TechCrunch, Shell Foundation) vs at least $3,690 in early 2017 (founders); each figure is used for its own date. RainMaker price: $500 (SEE Change) vs $100 deposit plus $45-65/month (founders); story uses the founders' terms. Founding year 2011/2012/2013 differs by source; story gives none. Unit counts taken from Shell Foundation (900 in pilot, 10,000+ by 2020, ~40,000 by 2023); other reports give different later totals.
notes: RainMaker launch dated October 2017 from the founders' Shell Foundation article (published 12 December 2017). Ibrahim rejected the word 'pivot' in January 2017; the story reports that while setting the arc to change-of-direction. The repeat screen flagged Mo Ibrahim (shared surname, different person) but let it through; no fields were reworded. Ecclesiasticus chapter 29 has other verses used in three editions; verses 1-2 are new.
